Data.subject: Labour, Employment, Wages and Productivity
Data.title: Central Provident Fund Members By Age Group (End Of Period), Annual
Data.footnote: Refer to persons (including self-employed) who have CPF balances in any of their CPF accounts.  The number of CPF members dropped in 2024 due to closure of foreigners' accounts.  Data exclude member(s) whose information on their date of birth are unavailable.

row.footnote: Prior to 2019, age group 'Up to 20' includes members between ages 13 to 20.  From 2019 onwards, age groups are based on actual ages (i.e., from 0 to 20).
